name: Absolute Log-Ratio
tagline: Per-token KL penalty equals the absolute log-ratio between current and reference policy log-probs.
diff_from_baseline: verl's `kl_penalty="abs"` branch. Symmetric, nonnegative, robust-to-outliers alternative to the squared k2 estimator.

name: K1 (Naive)
tagline: Schulman's k1 Monte Carlo KL — unbiased but high-variance, can take negative values.
diff_from_baseline: Schulman 2020 (Approximating KL divergence). Unbiased but noisy; corresponds to verl's `kl_penalty in {"kl","k1"}`.

name: K2 (Squared)
tagline: Half the squared log-ratio — Schulman's biased low-variance KL estimator.
diff_from_baseline: Schulman 2020. Biased but always nonnegative and lower variance than k1; verl's `kl_penalty in {"mse","k2"}`.

name: K3 (Low-variance, default)
tagline: Schulman's k3 unbiased low-variance estimator with numerical clamps; verl's default GRPO KL loss.
diff_from_baseline: Schulman 2020; used as default GRPO KL by DeepSeekMath (Shao et al. 2024) and verl. Unbiased and nonnegative in expectation, with much lower variance than k1.
